authority: Exact reviewed disposition of the two native Codex skill metadata surfaces introduced by Native Codex Autonomy Stage 0.
policy: Lifecycle classification records repository-tooling ownership and exact reviewed reachability only; it grants no credential access, business-data ownership, production write capability, provider access, telephony capability, or scan exemption.

surfaces.approved_architecture_path: repository-scoped native Codex skill discovery metadata for the explicitly invoked yoko-ci-triage workflow
surfaces.evidence: The exact six-line YAML contains display metadata, a bounded default prompt, and allow_implicit_invocation: false. The prompt requests repository-scoped diagnosis, repair, validation, and a normal Git push when an Operator explicitly invokes the skill, but the YAML itself grants no executor, credential, filesystem permission, workflow trigger, production access, database or provider client, or external-action capability. The tracked-surface scanner nevertheless conservatively enrolls every .yaml file as an operational surface.
